scope: P0 diagnostic: 32 existing regression controls plus 8 authored demand cases; artificial January–March 2025 coverage
limitations: Nonrepresentative author sample, not real user frequency or general accuracy.
No SQL, numerical reconciliation, provider, portal, or end-to-end latency evaluated.
aggregation_scope, ranking_axis and derived_calculations are expected business semantics for missing capabilities, not approved wire-contract field proposals.
New questions become development data after this run. Existing gold_language_holdout.json remains unexecuted by this diagnostic.
Period coverage intentionally has three months; 12-month clarifications cannot establish support for annual distribution.
